## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical understanding of KCA workflows under real-world constraints (intermittent connectivity, mobile assets). It emphasizes policy binding, short-lived credentials, and offline checks that matter in urban drone operations.

## Key Concepts
- KCA enrollment flow with regional bootstrap
- SPIFFE IDs and workload trust domains
- Short-lived TLS certs and renewal strategy
- Region-based policy binding and revocation semantics
- In-flight offline revocation checks and key rotation
- Auditing/logging requirements and loss scenarios

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudo-enrollment outline
function enrollDrone(droneId, region) {
  const csr = createCSR(droneId, region, 'drone-delivery');
  const cert = centralKCA.enroll(csr, ttl=300);
  storeCertAndKey(cert, privateKey);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test mid-flight reconnect latency and its impact on trust establishment?
- What metrics would you collect to verify policy drift and revocation effectiveness during flight?
